name: comfyui

COMFYUI_HOST.description: Host:port of a running ComfyUI server (e.g. 127.0.0.1:8188). Defaults to 127.0.0.1:8188.

COMFYUI_API_BASE.description: Full API base URL. Overrides COMFYUI_HOST when set (use for hosted/HTTPS deployments).

WORKFLOW_DIR.description: Directory containing reusable workflow JSON graphs. Defaults to ./workflows.

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory to write generated images into. Defaults to ./output.

notes: Wraps a running ComfyUI server. ADVISOR tier — generated outputs are previewed before write-out since image gen can be expensive (GPU time, queue saturation). Requires a separately-running ComfyUI server; the adapter does not spawn it. License is GPL-3.0.
